export default "# Discover the Serenity of Jiuzhaigou Valley\n\n![Jiuzhaigou Valley](/images/explore/jiuzhaigou.jpg)\n\nJiuzhaigou Valley is a nature reserve in the north of Sichuan Province. It is known for its many multi-level waterfalls, colorful lakes, and snow-capped peaks.\n\n## Highlights\n\n- **Colored Lakes**: The stunning hues of the lakes are due to the reflection of the surrounding forest and the calcified rocks on the lake bed.\n- **Waterfalls**: Witness the magnificent Nuorilang Waterfall, one of the widest in China.\n\n## How to Get There\n\nJiuzhaigou is accessible by bus or flight from Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province.\n\n[Back to Explore](/#/explore)";
